item.title: Taiwan opens first hydrogen refuelling stations in test of clean fuel push
item.description: State-run CPC and Linde LienHwa launch pilot sites in Kaohsiung as government weighs hydrogen’s role in energy transition.

item.title: How climate change reshaped the wild in 2025
item.description: Around the world, rising temperatures and erratic weather are forcing animals to adapt in startling ways – with consequences for people and ecosystems alike.

item.title: How insurance can transform our resilience to climate shocks
item.description: From Hurricane Melissa in the Caribbean to floods in Southeast Asia, insurance is an underused tool for adaptation to climate extremes.

item.title: South Korea targets 30 per cent cut in plastic waste by 2030
item.description: A new government roadmap raises levies and curbs single-use plastics, but critics say it ignores production cuts.

item.title: IEA: Declining coal demand in China set to outweigh Trump’s pro-coal policies
item.description: China’s coal demand is set to drop by 2027, more than cancelling out the effects of the Trump administration’s coal-friendly policies in the US, according to the International Energy Agency (IEA).

item.title: Eco-Business’ 10 most read stories of 2025
item.description: From flood control scandals that swallowed billions in public funds to Indigenous resistance against palm oil bulldozers, Eco-Business’ 10 most-read stories show how extreme weather, geopolitics and rushed renewables are sharpening the urgency – and complexity – of climate action across Asia.

item.title: Taiwan’s green jobs gap nears 30,000 as net zero drive lifts demand
item.description: Demand for sustainability skills outpaces supply, with semiconductor and tech sectors accounting for one-fifth of unmet jobs, says the island’s environment ministry.

item.title: Hydrogen emissions are ‘supercharging’ the warming impact of methane
item.description: The warming impact of hydrogen has been “overlooked” in projections of climate change, according to authors of the latest “global hydrogen budget”.

item.title: Malaysian climate watchdog takes government to court over greenwashing oversight
item.description: Rimbawatch wants court to clarify ministries’ duty to act on greenwashing after complaint was passed between agencies.

item.title: Five trends that will shape sustainability in Asia Pacific in 2026
item.description: Will the region see a surge of clean power for cross-border electricity trade? Can stricter measures be enforced with the environmental impacts spurred by the AI boom? Here are the key developments to look out for in the coming year.
